name: @dsh-mobile/mobile-web
description: Android-first Capacitor shell with camera pairing and direct WebRTC tunnel

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dsh-mobile/ui-layout-mobile && vite build && node scripts/package-local-shell.mjs && node scripts/package-browser-shell.mjs
scripts.android:copy: npm run build && cap copy android && node scripts/package-android-layout.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/package-android-layout.mjs
